title: Act: Add the three ui SVG files under game/public/assets/ui
summary: Create sound.svg, panel-frame.svg and pointer.svg in the ui folders.
description: Create the three files with the same content as game/frontend/public/assets/ui so the folders are tracked by git.
acceptance_criteria: Given the repo, When the ui folders are listed, Then each holds one non-empty SVG
Given each file, When read, Then it matches the file of the same name under game/frontend/public/assets/ui

steps.action: Create the file with the same single-line SVG as game/frontend/public/assets/ui/icons/sound.svg (16x16 speaker glyph).
steps.code: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" shape-rendering="crispEdges"><rect x="2" y="6" width="4" height="4" fill="#f0e0b0"/><rect x="6" y="3" width="4" height="10" fill="#f0e0b0"/></svg>

steps.action: Create the file with the same SVG as game/frontend/public/assets/ui/frames/panel-frame.svg (24x24 frame).
steps.code: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" shape-rendering="crispEdges"><rect width="24" height="24" fill="#2a1f1a"/><rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="18" fill="#4a3828"/></svg>

steps.action: Create the file with the same SVG as game/frontend/public/assets/ui/cursors/pointer.svg (16x16 cursor).
steps.code: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" shape-rendering="crispEdges"><rect x="2" y="2" width="2" height="10" fill="#fff"/><rect x="4" y="4" width="2" height="6" fill="#fff"/></svg>
